verdict.rationale: Model evaluation is a fair question for a fraud-decisioning product, but the evidence pack never documents merchant-facing precision/recall metrics or a shadow-mode trial capability. The only related item says Riskified's own analytics team transfers and calibrates models before a go-live date, which is vendor-side onboarding work rather than a tool the finance lead can use. The Integration Console only validates API integration data, not model performance.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can measure the model itself — precision and recall on my traffic, shadow-mode trials of new models or rules before they take over decisions
